policy: Only named documentation reconciliation files are local edits; all listed candidate packages and narrative/reference dependencies remain immutable external references. Source code, tools, assets, packaging and protected baseline records are not copied.
closurePolicy: All 132 relative source links resolve to pinned Git paths. Inherited anchor exceptions are retained as source defects; local custody uses immutable line URLs and compatible original-section anchors instead of broken fragments. No claim is made about third-party provider endpoints.
